item.title: Video analysis can follow faster movement
item.summary: For exercise form, quick action, or a brief moment, Murph can now look at more points in the video before answering.
item.details: Ordinary video questions keep the lighter analysis. Every request still makes one pass, and visible form feedback stays observational rather than diagnostic.

tryIt.label: Ask about a video
tryIt.prompt: Check my form in this video and tell me what you can see in the movement.
